exposure: history of loop electrosurgical excision procedure (conisation)
History of loop electrosurgical excision procedure (conisation)
cohort: 57 nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies and previous conisation and 100 age-matched pregnant controls without history of conisation
finding: While women with a history of conisation had a lower gestational age at delivery, they did not have a higher risk of prematurity and had a lower rate of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Women with a history of conisation had a lower rate of caesarean section.
gest_age: Lower gestational age at delivery in the conisation group
